one_line: Global payments and financial infrastructure platform with a very broad REST API for payments, billing, subscriptions, payouts, and connect.
auth_notes: API keys (secret/publishable, sk_test/sk_live restricted keys) issued from the Dashboard; OAuth2 used for Stripe Connect platform accounts. Keys sent via HTTP Basic/Bearer. Test-mode keys available immediately without a live business.
self_serve_notes: Free self-serve signup — instant sandbox (test mode) keys; live mode enabled after minimal account activation. Pay-as-you-go; no up-front fee.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Hundreds of endpoints across payments, billing, subscriptions, checkouts, connect, issuing, terminal, treasury, tax, identity, reporting, and more; plus webhook/event destinations.
api_surface.webhook_note: Mature webhook support via webhook endpoints and event destinations (v2); signed payloads with configurable events.

existing_mcp.note: Stripe publishes an official MCP server (stripe-mcp); multiple community MCP servers also exist.

evidence.note: Fetched text of Stripe API reference confirms REST architecture, API key auth, error model, and broad resource list.

agent_notes: Confident on all fields from fetched API reference text.
